DeviceBridgeTEST BUILD v0.7.0
LET'S CHECK YOUR TWO PCs

One app. A clear test.

Download this same test build on both Windows PCs. Audio and window fix: system capture works without a physical speaker on supported Windows, the shared microphone has a selector and live level, and X keeps the session running in the tray. Both PCs must use this build. Physical two-PC testing is still in progress.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit · One file · Test build v0.7.0

Start here

  1. Close ALL older DeviceBridge copies, including renamed downloads such as DeviceBridge (1).exe. Check that both window titles show 0.7. Open this test build on both PCs on the same trusted router (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or both).
  2. On the PC with your favorite devices, choose the first option. Copy its key. On the other PC, choose the second option, paste the six-character key and click Connect & allow. There is no separate approval popup on the first PC.
  3. If pairing fails, use Fix connection / network access beside the key on both PCs. Choose your trusted router adapter, allow this app with Windows approval, then retry. If needed, copy the first PC’s displayed connection address into More options on the other PC and use the same six-character key.
  4. On the first PC, choose Left, Right, Above or Below to match the other screen. Move across that edge and back; repeat for each position. F8 also switches control. Ctrl+Alt+Esc disconnects immediately.
  5. Open Check my setup on the other PC, click its typing field, then move the first PC’s mouse across the chosen screen edge. Try typing, clicking, dragging and scrolling. Move back through the joining edge to return. No switch button is needed.
  6. On the first PC, open Check my setup and ask the other PC to send a headphone test. Confirm that you hear it through the first PC.
  7. For microphone sharing, install the included VB-CABLE driver on the other PC if needed, approve Windows access and restart. Reconnect, check that Share my microphone is on and choose the correct microphone on the first PC, then select CABLE Output in the calling app on the other PC.
  8. Speak on the first PC. Check both the other PC's incoming level meter and its calling app's microphone test. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
  9. Keep the session open for two minutes. Minimize, maximize and restore each window. Close an active window with X, then open DeviceBridge again: the same session should return. Use the tray’s Disconnect and quit when exiting. Try saved reconnection and Ctrl+Alt+Esc. Then use Copy report in each connected session and send both reports back in your chat, labelled PC A and PC B. Include which devices passed or failed.

Reports contain device names, counts and timing. They do not contain typed text, audio recordings, pairing keys or private IP addresses. This app is unsigned; Windows may warn. Do not treat automated checks as proof that the devices work on your two PCs.

Included microphone driver: VB-CABLE by VB-Audio, donationware. Contributions and license purchases are welcome. Licensing & support; professional deployments need appropriate licensing.
